# FQHELatticeShowBasis

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnLattice` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnLattice/FQHELatticeShowBasis`

```text
FQHELatticeShowBasis, version 0.01

Usage: FQHELatticeShowBasis [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --input-files : input state file name(s) (multiple arguments)
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles of target many-body state (default value = 0)
    -x, --lx : length in x-direction of given lattice (grabbed from condensate) (default value = 0)
    -y, --ly : length in y-direction of given lattice (grabbed from condensate) (default value = 0)
    -q, --flux : number of flux quanta piercing the lattice (grabbed from condensate) (default value = 0)
    -c, --hard-core : Use Hilbert-space of hard-core bosons (~Gutzwiller projection)
    -n, --no-hard-core : Do not use Hilbert-space of hard-core bosons (overriding detection from filename)
    -r, --first-real : Multiply each vector with a phase such that the first non-zero coefficient is real
    -P, --polar : Show coefficients in the polar (abs,phase) representation
    -e, --real-element : Index of element to be made real with option 'first-real' (default value = 0)
    --hide-component : hide state components (and thus the corresponding n-body state) whose absolute value is lower than a given error (0 if all components have to be shown (default value = 0)
    -k, --ky : constraint of momentum in y-direction (default value = 0)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
